What_to_learn: Teach operating rhythm early if LiveOps is core promise
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not flood FTUE with mature-title density

What_to_learn: Budget attention/click depth as a resource
What_NOT_to_copy: More events is not automatically better
Do not copy 100 events/month into lean team

What_to_learn: Weekly story can be a retention contract
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not promise weekly story without production capacity

What_to_learn: Explore many creatives then concentrate delivery on winners
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not equate creative breadth with spend breadth

What_to_learn: Separate acquisition volume from installed-base value
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not infer LTV/ARPPU or event causality
